purpose: Lets the user choose exactly one option from a short, visible list. Each option is a square radio with a square mark.

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; description?: string; disabled?: boolean }>
props.description: Options, each with an optional description line

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stack or row. Defaults to vertical

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error below the group; sets the error state

whenToUse: For two to six mutually exclusive options that should all be visible
When the options need a short description each
whenNotToUse: For many options — use Select or Combobox
For on/off settings — use Switch or Checkbox
For a compact view switch — use SegmentedControl
antiPatterns: A single radio on its own
Leaving no option selected when one is required and has a sensible default

anatomy: Group label, options each with a 20px square radio in a 40px hit area, label and optional description, helper or error text
sizes: Radio `size-control-indicator` (20px) with a `border-width-control` border; hit area `size-hit-area` (40px)
states: Selected: `color-interactive-default` frame and square mark; hover and press `color-state-layer`; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`; error `color-border-danger`; disabled at `opacity-disabled`
motion: Mark scales in with `motion-easing-enter` over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: role radiogroup named by its label
Arrow keys move the selection and skip disabled options; Tab enters and leaves the group
Error text is linked by aria-describedby
